jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About us:

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.



About the role:

We’re looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to strengthen the systems that power our go-to-market teams.

This is a builder role for someone who can design, implement, and own the processes, workflows, automations, and data architecture that accelerate how we find, engage, win, onboard, retain, and expand customers at scale. You will partner across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnership to turn fragmented systems and manual work into a high-leverage GTM engine.

If you naturally think: “This should be an automated system, not a spreadsheet.” …you’ll likely be a strong fit. We would love to connect with you about enabling our rapidly growing revenue team. You will play a key role in increasing internal efficiency and productivity to support the team in creating the best customer experience, and in driving commercial success.



Your responsibilities will include:

 - CRM and revenue tech stack architecture
   
   - Own end-to-end CRM administration as the single source of truth for revenue activities
   
   - Manage the design, configuration, and roadmap of a connected revenue tech stack
   
   - Set and enforce data governance standards: field hygiene, deduplication, permissions, and ongoing data-quality monitoring

 - Automation and data foundation
   
   - Automate and enrich the manual layer with workflows and LLMs
   
   - Build and maintain operational dashboards (recurring KPIs, data hygiene, system adoption)
   
   - Advise with thought leadership on which tooling we procure next as we scale

 - Cross-functional partnership and enablement
   
   - Operational business partner to GTM leadership
   
   - Drive systems and process adoption across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnership teams through training and enablement
   
   - Act as first point of contact for revenue system support tickets



What success looks like in 12 months:

 - GTM signals are consistently translated into actionable workflows

 - Sellers and customer-facing teams spend materially less time on manual admin and prep

 - Critical revenue systems are connected, key workflows are AI-assisted or fully automated

 - Leadership has a real-time view into pipeline, conversion, execution, and customer health



You're a great fit if you:

 - 5+ years in Revenue/Sales Operations in a B2B SaaS hypergrowth environment

 - Deep hands-on expertise in CRM administration (HubSpot/Salesforce)

 - Proven track record building revenue systems, processes, and data flows from scratch

 - Persistent problem-solver at your core

 - Sharp entrepreneurial instincts and analytical mindset

 - Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management



What you can look forward to:

 - Taking full ownership of high-leverage systems and delivering work that directly impacts pipeline, productivity, and revenue

 - Helping shape how a category-defining AI company builds and scales its go-to-market engine from the ground up

 - A competitive compensation and equity package that reflects the leverage and strategic importance of the role
   
   



At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (Remote-USA)
jobs.description:
About DeepJudge:

DeepJudge is the intelligence layer for legal work. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, we help legal teams unlock the institutional knowledge trapped inside their organizations, through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure.

Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, and Schoenherr, as well as leading Fortune 500 corporate legal teams. We are headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, backed by a $42.2M Series A led by Felicis with continued support from Coatue. Recent launches such as SuperSearch and partnerships with Thomson Reuters and Harvey reflect the increasing adoption of DeepJudge across legal workflows.

 

At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it.

 

If you are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences and building lasting client relationships, we would love to connect with you about joining our rapidly growing team as a Customer Success Manager. You will play a key role in transforming the way large law firms leverage technology to drive efficiency and profitability. 

 

Your responsibilities will include:

Retention & Growth: Monitor client satisfaction, identify upsell opportunities, and ensure renewals by driving ROI for our clients.

Client Onboarding: Guide new clients through successful implementation and onboarding, tailoring strategies to meet their unique needs.

Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for your portfolio of clients, fostering strong, long-term relationships.

Project & Stakeholder Management: Coordinate cross-functional projects and manage stakeholder expectations to ensure smooth execution and client success.

Presentations & Training: Lead engaging training sessions and business reviews with senior professionals.

Issue Resolution: Proactively address client concerns and resolve issues with professionalism and efficiency.

Insights & Feedback: Gather client feedback to drive continuous improvement and contribute to product development.

What we are looking for:

 - Experience: 5+ years in a customer success, client-facing, or account management role, ideally in a SaaS or legal technology environment.

 - Professionalism: Polished communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently engage senior legal professionals.

 - Legal Expertise (Nice to Have): A Juris Doctor (J.D.) or prior experience practicing law is highly preferred, demonstrating an in-depth understanding of legal workflows and client needs.

 - Tech-Savvy: Comfortable navigating and explaining complex software, with a keen intellectual curiosity and passion for emerging technologies, including AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

 - Strategic & Self-Directed: A proactive and entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to thrive in a dynamic "startup/scale-up" environment where you will help build processes rather than simply follow a pre-existing playbook.

 - Detail-Oriented: A meticulous approach to managing tasks, timelines, and client requests.

 - Responsive & Reliable: Ability to effectively manage a book of business and multiple clients, ensuring prompt and thoughtful communication.

 - Global Collaboration: Ability to work effectively within our dynamic international environment which requires a degree of flexibility to accommodate regular meetings and real-time collaboration across different time zones (including Europe).

What you can look forward to: 

 - The opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies in the LegalTech and AI space

 - The ability to work remotely within a global company

 - Competitive salary and incentives

 - A supportive and collaborative company culture that values your contributions
   
   Compensation is determined based on role level, location, skills, and experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The expected compensation range is $125,000 OTE and $175,000 OTE. Eligible employees may also receive incentives and benefits as part of the total compensation package including equity. This position is open to candidates who are legally authorized to work in the United States.

jobs.description:

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

 

About the role:

We are looking for a Technology Partner Manager who wants to become part of a world-class AI / Legal Tech startup. You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Legal to help build and scale our technology partnership ecosystem. In this role, you will focus on identifying, negotiating, activating, and cultivating strategic technology partnerships that expand DeepJudge’s reach, strengthen our market position, and contribute to pipeline growth.

 

Your responsibilities will include:

 - Identify, evaluate, and prioritize technology partners whose platforms, integrations, and market presence can strengthen DeepJudge’s ecosystem and accelerate go-to-market impact

 - Lead partnership conversations from initial outreach through negotiation and signature, moving quickly while balancing commercial value, strategic fit, and long-term relationship health

 - Activate newly signed partners by coordinating internally across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Legal to turn agreements into real launches, joint value propositions, and operational momentum

 - Cultivate existing partnerships by developing joint plans, maintaining strong partner relationships, and driving ongoing engagement after signature rather than treating the deal as the finish line

 - Help define how DeepJudge works with partners in a rapidly evolving vertical, navigating ambiguity with sound judgment and professionalism

 - Surface market feedback and partner insights to internal teams so that product strategy, integration priorities, and partner motions stay aligned with customer demand

 - Contribute to measuring partner success across marketing contribution, sales pipeline influence, and broader go-to-market impact as our partnerships program continues to mature

 - Bring proactive ideas on how DeepJudge can deepen its strategic position in legal AI through partnerships, integrations, and differentiated ecosystem execution

 

You're a great fit if you:

 - You have 3+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, or a related commercial role in B2B SaaS

 - You have a strong commercial mindset and understand how partnerships and integrations can create meaningful go-to-market impact, not just technical outcomes

 - You are an excellent relationship builder and negotiator, able to work effectively with external partners as well as internal stakeholders across product, legal, engineering, and sales

 - You are comfortable operating in ambiguity, especially in fast-moving markets where collaboration and competition can coexist at the same time

 - You bring sound judgment, humility, and a strong desire to learn, and you are motivated by building something new in a high-growth environment

 - You can move quickly from first conversation to signed agreement while staying organized, strategic, and detail-oriented throughout the process

 - You are able to understand technical concepts and integration-related discussions well enough to engage credibly with product and engineering teams

 - You communicate effectively and with full proficiency in English

 

What you can look forward to:

 - You will be able to take on meaningful ownership from day 1 in a role with clear visibility and strategic importance to the business

 - You will help shape and scale a growing partnerships function at a company that sits in a uniquely important position within the legal AI ecosystem

 - You will work on high-impact initiatives across multiple teams and gain exposure to product, go-to-market, and strategic decision-making at a fast-growing startup

 - You will be part of an ambitious, thoughtful, and collaborative team that values rigor, learning, and continuous improvement

Compensation is determined based on role level, location, skills, and experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The range is $170,000 - $200,000 OTE + equity. Eligible employees may also receive incentives and benefits as part of the total compensation package. This position is open to candidates who are legally authorized to work in the United States.

 

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About DeepJudge:
Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you.

About the role:



DeepJudge is growing rapidly across North America, working with some of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams. As our presence in the market continues to expand, we’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager, North America to own and develop our field marketing strategy and tactics across the region. 

This is a highly visible role at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how DeepJudge shows up in the market, from our presence at the industry’s most important conferences to executive experiences, customer programs, partner activations, and highly targeted initiatives to strengthen our positioning in the market.

You’ll own programs from strategy through execution, thinking holistically about the audiences we want to reach, the experiences we create, how we activate across channels, and how each initiative contributes to our broader growth strategy.
You’ll work closely with our commercial team to understand where the biggest opportunities are and translate those into creative, high-impact field programs. You’ll also collaborate with the broader Marketing team to connect field initiatives with our content, product launches, customer stories, partnerships, and integrated campaigns.

We’re looking for someone who combines commercial thinking with creativity and exceptional execution – someone excited by the opportunity to build, experiment, and continuously grow the field marketing function as we scale.




Your responsibilities will include:

 - Develop a deep understanding of target personas, market trends and the competitive landscape to inform campaign planning, messaging and event positioning in the region.

 - Evolve DeepJudge’s North American field strategy and program calendar, aligned with our GTM priorities and growth ambitions.

 - Partner closely with Sales to understand regional priorities, target accounts, active opportunities, and customer relationships, and translate these into impactful field programs.

 - Lead our presence at conferences, developing the strategy and activation around each opportunity from planning through execution and follow-up.

 - Create integrated programs around key market moments, connecting field activities with content, digital activation, customer advocacy, partner marketing, and sales outreach.

 - Develop DeepJudge-hosted experiences including executive dinners, roundtables, customer gathering, workshops, and other creative formats designed for our audience.

 - Build target and account-based programs for priority firms, prospects, and buying committees.

 - Bring our customers into the hard of our field strategy through speaking opportunities, peer-to-peer conversations, customer-led experiences, and advocacy.

 - Collaborate with our strategic partners on joint events, activations, and programs that extend our reach and create value for shared audiences.

 - Work closely with Product Marketing, Integrated Growth, Content, Marketing Operations, Customer Success, and Sales to bring campaigns and company priorities to life in the North American market.

 - Own end-to-end program delivery, including budgets, agencies, venues, vendors, production, timelines, logistics, and onsite execution.

 - Develop repeatable formats and playbooks that allow successful field programs to scale across markets, audiences, and moments throughout the year.

 - Track and evaluate performance across engagement, meetings, opportunities, pipeline contribution, and ROI, using insights to continuously evolve our approach.

 - Stay close to the market and proactively identify new communities, formats, partnerships, and opportunities for DeepJudge to engage our audience.

 - Build and nurture relationships with key industry associations, publications and strategic partners to strengthen DeepJudge’s visibility and credibility in the legal tech space and reach a broader audience.



You're a great fit if you:

 - Have 5+ years of experience in B2B field marketing, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environment. Experience in legal tech is a strong plus.

 - Have owned field programs end-to-end and can demonstrate how your work has contributed to pipeline and business growth.

 - Have experience partnering closely with enterprise Sales teams and understand how field marketing supports complex buying journeys and strategic accounts.

 - Think holistically about field marketing and understand how events, ABM, partners, customers, content, and digital activation can work together.

 - Bring strong commercial judgment and can prioritize opportunities based on audience relevance and potential business impact.

 - Are highly creative and enjoy developing experiences and programs that stand out and genuinely engage an enterprise audience.

 - Are an exceptional project manager who can manage multiple programs, stakeholders, timelines, and budgets simultaneously.

 - Are equally comfortable developing a strategy, presenting an idea, briefing a team, negotiating with a vendor, and being onsite making sure everything comes together.

 - Are data-driven and comfortable using CRM and marketing data to understand performance and inform decisions.

 - Thrive in a fast-paced environment with high ownership and room to experiment.

 - Are an excellent communicator and relationship builder.

 - Are willing to travel across North America.

 - While this position is remote, we strongly prefer candidates located in or working during Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours
   
   

What you can look forward to:

 - Shaping the future of a high-impact deep-tech AI startup

 - A fast-paced learning path, where you grow professionally every day

 - Competitive compensation, flexible working arrangements, fun work environment


Compensation is determined based on role level, location, skills, and experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The expected compensation range is $145,000 and $165,000 plus equity. Eligible employees may also receive incentives and benefits as part of the total compensation package including equity. This position is open to candidates who are legally authorized to work in the United States.



At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. 

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.
